meta.name: herdr-opencode-server
meta.description: OpenCode's server in a Herdr pane (herdr-nono-plugin). The server runs the model loop and every tool. Egress goes through nono's proxy to an allowlist of LLM provider hosts (GitHub Copilot) and OpenCode's model catalog; direct TCP connects are denied, and the proxy refuses every other host, including every name for localhost, so the OpenCode host service on 127.0.0.1:4096 is out of reach. Never add "*", localhost, IP addresses or wildcard DNS names: nono's proxy connects to whatever an allowed name resolves to. Pathname AF_UNIX mediation keeps Herdr's control socket, systemd, D-Bus and the SSH and GPG agents out of reach. The plugin grants the workspace root and the server's listen port per launch.
